# everything-webgpu

> Run local MLC/WebLLM models on WebGPU in the browser with a priority scheduler, multi-step decoding, and zero-network disk loading.

## Documentation
- [Quick Start](https://github.com/nyaaorick/everything-webgpu#quick-start--four-lines): 4-line engine initialization.
- [API Reference](https://github.com/nyaaorick/everything-webgpu/blob/main/API.md): Comprehensive API catalog and error specifications.
- [Benchmarks & Architecture](https://github.com/nyaaorick/everything-webgpu/blob/main/AI.md): Measured performance, Firefox patch analysis, and scheduler design.

## Core Capabilities
- **Scheduler**: Interactive, normal, and background priority bands with session-based supersession for ghost-text autocompletion.
- **Multi-step Decoding**: Aggregates K forward steps per GPU sync, increasing 0.8B decode speed from 9.6 to 25.9 tok/s.
- **Offline Disk Loading**: Direct model ingestion via Drag-and-Drop or HTML directory inputs with zero network dependency.
- **Firefox WebGPU Patches**: Overcomes the 9-storage-buffer cap and flushes compute passes efficiently.
